$comment2: textParam marks a component whose visible text is its own child text content rather than an attribute — app-button reads this.innerHTML (app-button.js:80), app-badge and app-tag are styled wrappers around their text. Without it the model can emit them and they render empty.
$comment: Hand-maintained decisions the generated design-system catalog cannot express: which components a generated surface may name, which take children or data as their first positional argument, and which attributes to withhold. gen-dsl-catalog.mjs merges this with design-system/catalog.json to produce dsl-catalog.json. Every component in catalog.json must have an entry here — `--check` fails otherwise, so a new component forces an explicit decision instead of silently becoming available or silently missing.

app-table.reason: The renderer registers the resolved rows as a synthetic source and sets data-fn itself. Leaving it settable would let a surface point the table at any registered source and bypass that.

app-toolbar.note: Only useful with Slot() — its content is entirely start/end slotted.

app-empty-state.reason: icon is SVG markup written unescaped by contract — the one markup sink in the design system. Use the icon slot instead.

app-avatar.note: size/filled/interactive/disabled/state are CSS-only (app-avatar.css:86-113) rather than non-functional. They are absent from observedAttributes because nothing in JS re-runs on change; the renderer recreates elements per pass, so that costs nothing here.

app-button.reason: href is route-typed and there is no route allowlist to validate against yet. The button is still useful as an Action trigger; re-include href once core/routes.json exists.

app-card.reason: Same as app-button — route-typed attributes stay out until the allowlist exists.

app-chart.reason: Declares no dataSource or data attribute, so there is no confirmed way to feed it rows from a DSL expression. Needs a read of app-chart.js to find the real mechanism; if it is a JS property, propAssignments covers it.

app-tabs.reason: Selects its children by [role="tab"], .tab (app-tabs.js:23,174) — an ARIA-role contract, not a slot attribute, so Slot() cannot express it. Needs its own marker mechanism.

app-loading-bar.reason: Zero attributes; driven by global document events, not composition.

app-input.reason: A form control with no value plumbing until $state and Action land.

app-select.reason: A form control with no value plumbing until $state and Action land.

app-search.reason: A form control with no value plumbing until $state and Action land.

app-checkbox.reason: A form control with no value plumbing until $state and Action land.

app-radio.reason: A form control with no value plumbing until $state and Action land.

app-switch.reason: A form control with no value plumbing until $state and Action land.

app-chatbox.reason: Needs Action wiring to do anything; revisit once Action ships.

auto-complete.reason: Needs a live filter callback through data-sources.js — not designed yet.
